Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one tiny illustrated location icon for a warm wooden Monopoly board game, a standalone transparent PNG sprite for later integration, NOT a board mockup. Style: match the project's cute Shiba and red-panda avatar illustrations: soft hand-painted watercolor/gouache, rounded simple silhouettes, buttery cream highlights, pastel colors, subtle paper pigment texture INSIDE the painted object only, minimal fine linework, no dark heavy outlines, charming cozy storybook game art. This is an OBJECT icon, not an animal mascot. Compact three-quarter/front view, centered, entire silhouette uncut, fills about 76% of a square canvas, generous fully transparent margins. The icon must remain recognizable at 40–56px. 2-4 large color shapes and only essential details. It will straddle a board tile edge, so the silhouette is free-standing, with no rectangular or circular backdrop, no badge, no white sticker border, no ground plane, no scene/background, no text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark. Genuine RGBA transparent background. No photorealism, 3D render, gradients as background or drop shadow.
Subject: Jingdezhen, China. ONE plump ivory-white traditional Chinese porcelain vase, short narrow neck with a flared lip, softly rounded pear-shaped body, a few bold cobalt-blue hand-painted leaf/floral curves and a blue rim. Light powder-blue shading, warm cream highlights. Elegantly simplified blue-and-white porcelain, not a teapot. No flowers sticking out, no extra pottery, no pedestal.

Subject: Mount Huangshan, China. A tiny compact cluster of TWO rounded but steep pale warm-gray granite pinnacles, one recognizable windswept Chinese pine growing sideways from the larger rock with a curved brown trunk and two broad sage-green umbrella-shaped foliage pads. A small cream-white curl of mist hugs the lower rocks. Readable iconic mountain/pine silhouette, broad minimal shapes, no realistic landscape or scenery panel, no sun, no background mountains.

Subject: Las Vegas, Nevada, USA. A miniature retro roadside marquee SIGN INSPIRED BY the recognizable Las Vegas welcome sign silhouette: chunky horizontal cream diamond-shaped sign with rounded points, warm coral-red inset border, very few large butter-yellow light dots, one cheerful coral-and-honey eight-point starburst at its top-left and two short muted teal supporting posts. The face contains ONLY THREE simple large coral four-point sparkle shapes as pictograms, absolutely NO words or pseudo-lettering. A single unified sign object, no buildings, dice, casino chips or additional props. Compact proportions, soft painted colors, no neon glow outside the object.

Subject: Seattle, Washington, USA. A single cute simplified Space Needle tower with its iconic wide flying-saucer observation deck, flattened warm-cream oval roof, one muted terracotta orange cap/needle, soft dusty-teal window band, three pale cool-gray tapering legs that spread gently at the base. Stylized squat compact proportions for tiny icon readability while retaining the iconic Space Needle silhouette. Warm highlights, just enough structure to recognize it. No skyline, coffee cup, clouds, plants, text or terrain.

Subject: shared Water Works utility icon for both China and USA boards. One friendly chunky old-fashioned WATER FAUCET in dusty pastel blue/teal, short rounded horizontal spout curved downward at right, a small rounded coral cross-handle on top, with ONE large clear sky-blue teardrop directly below the spout. Delicate cream-white highlight on drop, warm pale-blue shading on faucet. Big simple shapes, slight three-quarter perspective, a compact unified faucet-and-drop silhouette.
